name: gc_skew
description: Plot support table (ADR-0043): windowed GC skew of every replicon, for V1 (GIAP_SPEC.md §10.2). Not a result table.

fields.name: end
fields.description: 1-based last position of the window (closed); the last window of a contig is shorter

fields.name: gc_skew
fields.description: (G - C) / (G + C) in the window; NA when G + C = 0

fields.name: cumulative_gc_skew
fields.description: Running sum of gc_skew from position 1 of the contig; an NA window adds 0
